target.itemsFoundBy: Elements with role="option" in the listbox.

tab.reason: [tab-out] With the popup closed, Tab left the combobox and Shift+Tab returned to it. [tab-open] With the popup shown, Tab left the combobox without stopping on the popup or an option.

expanded.reason: [tab-out] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after the one step judged (1 not judged). [tab-open] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 2 steps judged (1 not judged). [open-down] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after the one step judged (0 not judged). [type-then-move] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 4 steps judged (0 not judged). [ends] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 9 steps judged (0 not judged). [accept] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 3 steps judged (0 not judged). [escape] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 4 steps judged (0 not judged). [reopen] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after each of the 5 steps judged (0 not judged). [open-up] The expanded state matched whether options were in the tree after the one step judged (0 not judged). Not judged: [no-match] What a system shows for text that matches nothing is not judged.

down.summary: Down Arrow opens, no option active
down.reason: [open-down] Down Arrow showed the popup with 6 options and made none of them active. Follows in: [type-then-move] Down Arrow made the first option, "Apple", active.

basis.summary: Down Arrow opens, no option active
Down Arrow goes to the first option

focus-stays.reason: [type-then-move] In 3 arrow key steps DOM focus stayed on the combobox and aria-activedescendant named the active option. Not judged: [open-down] No arrow key made an option active, so there was nothing to judge. "Down Arrow goes to an option" covers it.

arrows.reason: [type-then-move] In 2 steps an arrow key moved from the active option to the next or the previous one. [ends] Down Arrow at the last option wraps; Up Arrow at the first option wraps.

basis.summary: Ends of the list as APG allows

selected.summary: Selected is not the active option
selected.reason: [type-then-move] After step 2, "Apple" was active and no option was exposed as selected.

basis.summary: Selected is not the active option

enter.reason: [accept] Enter closed the popup and put "Apple" in the combobox.

escape.reason: [escape] Escape closed the popup, focus stayed on the combobox, and it kept the text (recorded, not judged).

say-results.reason: [type-then-move] Nothing was written to a live region within the quiet window after the key that changed the suggestions, and no option became active.

say-count.reason: [type-then-move] Nothing was written to a live region, so there is no message whose count could be judged. Whether that differs is the business of "Say that the suggestions changed".
